name: Appartementpark Wilder Kaiser
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Appartementpark Wilder Kaiser is located on the outskirts of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, surrounded by meadows and forests with stunning views of the mountain landscape. The apartments come equipped with a kitchenette and either a balcony or a terrace. The property features a heated outdoor pool, a Finnish sauna, and a children’s playground. The town center with shopping options is just a few minutes’ walk away. In winter, access is available to the Wilder Kaiser ski region, and in summer, hiking trails start right from the house.
